evidence.quote: Problem 9. Same question, now for the tame automorphism subgroup: define Hi = Gi cap TAn(k). Question: TAn(k) =< H1, . . . , Hn >. And if yes, is TAn(k) = *Hi the amalgamated product along pairwise intersections?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $\mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ denote the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms of the polynomial ring $k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ (equivalently, polynomial automorphisms of affine $n$-space over $k$). Let $\mathrm{TA}_n(k) \le \mathrm{GA}_n(k)$ be the tame subgroup, that is, the subgroup generated by all affine automorphisms together with all elementary (triangular) automorphisms of the form $x_i \mapsto x_i + f(x_1,\dots,\hat{x_i},\dots,x_n)$ (with the other variables fixed).

For each $i \in \{1,\dots,n\}$, define
$$G_i \;=\; \{\,\varphi \in \mathrm{GA}_n(k) \;:\; \varphi(V_i)=V_i\,\},\qquad V_i := k \oplus kx_1 \oplus kx_2 \oplus \cdots \oplus kx_i,$$
the subgroup of polynomial automorphisms that stabilize the $k$-subspace $V_i \subset k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ setwise. Set
$$H_i \;=\; G_i \cap \mathrm{TA}_n(k).$$

Answer the following two questions:

(a) Is $\mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ generated by $H_1, H_2, \dots, H_n$, i.e. $\mathrm{TA}_n(k) = \langle H_1,\dots,H_n\rangle$?

(b) If so, is $\mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ isomorphic to the amalgamated product of the subgroups $H_1,\dots,H_n$ along their pairwise intersections $H_i \cap H_j$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is part of a list of open problems on automorphisms of affine spaces (2009). For $n=2$, the Jung–van der Kulk theorem gives an amalgamated free product structure (and $\mathrm{TA}_2(k)=\mathrm{GA}_2(k)$). For $n\ge 3$, the structure of $\mathrm{TA}_n(k)$ is much less understood; recent work on combinatorics of the tame automorphism group (e.g. Bisi–Furter–Maubach, Lamy and collaborators) studies such generation/amalgamation questions but no general affirmative answer for arbitrary $n\ge 3$ has been published. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems list (Automorphisms of Affine Spaces conference)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 9: define H_i = G_i ∩ TA_n(k). Question: TA_n(k)=<H_1,...,H_n>. And if yes, is TA_n(k)=*H_i the amalgamated product along pairwise intersections?
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Combinatorics of the tame automorphism group
status_evidence.snippet: Studies combinatorial/amalgamated structure of the tame automorphism group in dimension 3.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent works investigate such amalgamation structure for TA_n; no full resolution for arbitrary n is reported.
